status: First linked US revenue underwriting scenarios; conditional on launch, no PoS discount, no MonteCarlo or valuation conclusion
limitations: Model years are relative full commercial years;1yearIRlead is scenario timing,not updated regulatory forecast.
Population pools remain whole-market proxies; origin-specific composite rates implicitly include reach/eligibility.

Constant annual acquisition probabilities among remaining available patients; no imposed S-curve or sales-force acceleration. Rejected prescriptions retry after12months; discontinued paid users retire from reacquisition for model horizon, not from disease population.

Net1.5%population growth allocated to original groups. Origin tracks prior treatment, not current treatment. XR adoption alone changes rescue intensity for initially nonLTPgroups; other nonPHVS market migrations not modeled.
Rescue users are an overlapping membership population, not additional unique patients; retention90%is an operational carryover assumption, not measured continuous dispensing.

Within-origin XR/IR overlap uses proportional mixing, not observed joint adoption.50%dual-use share allocates rescue volume of PHVSXRusers toPHVSIR; remaining volume belongs to other rescue products. It is a prescribing scenario,not a clinical prohibition or demonstrated safety/compatibility finding.

IRdispensing8/14peryear uses historical proxies,includes nondispensers; no additional redosing haircut or zero-user multiplier. Initial2doses are inside annual budget,not on top. Actual packsize/freefirststock/expiry unknown.
XR418kannualnet and IR12.5–16knet/dose are pricing assumptions from dated sellside/comparator anchors,notPHVSannouncedprices. No futurepriceinflation,inventoryswings or additionalGTN applied.
Cautious/working/optimistic are bundled scenarios,not probability quantiles orconfidenceintervals.
Historical90%Daybuepaidconversion is an outsideHAEproxy; observedover-timeconversion definition incompletely specified and competitive landscape differs.
No current fair value inferred; USonly,exUScosts/tax/royalties/PoS/discounting excluded.
